popCulture.title: Acrisius
popCulture.description: The Argive king who locked Danae in bronze and cast her to sea — the grandfather Perseus' discus was fated to kill.

popCulture.title: Danaë
popCulture.description: Acrisius' daughter and the shower of gold — her imprisonment is the father's fear that made Perseus' birth inevitable.

popCulture.title: Clash of the Titans
popCulture.creator: Desmond Davis
popCulture.description: Harryhausen's film keeps Acrisius' oracle and the chest at sea as the opening move of Perseus' quest.
